funder: RBC Foundation / Royal Bank of Canada
amount_notes: Up to $500,000 per year for up to 5 years ($2.5M maximum). Typically funds no more than 20% of organization operating budget. Audited financials required for requests over $50,000. Seed funding exceptions for organizations under 5 years old.
organization_types_eligible: Registered charities or other qualified donees in Canada (RBC Foundation)
Registered charities, qualified donees, and non-profit organizations in communities where RBC has business presence (RBC direct)
Organizations at different sizes and stages considered
eligibility_criteria: Must be registered charity, qualified donee, or non-profit organization in Canada
Must operate in community where RBC has a business presence
Must have clear and measurable goals with demonstrated community impact
Must have strong financial management, multiple funding sources, and independent Board of Directors
Project must align with RBC ambitions: net-zero transition, skills for future, inclusive prosperity
exclusions: CRITICAL: Sports teams explicitly excluded unless they are a qualified donee
Private fee-based elementary or secondary schools
Trade associations, advocacy organizations, chambers of commerce
notes: IMPORTANT: The RBC Foundation Indigenous Youth Leadership Program listed in prior PathGrant reports does not exist as a standalone program. This is the actual RBC Foundation grant program. ELIGIBILITY RISK: Sports teams explicitly excluded unless qualified donee. Emerge Academy as a hockey academy may be classified as a sports team. Application must frame organization as education and Indigenous youth development NFP, not as a sports team. Rolling intake. No published deadline.
